page_title: VIL 4-1 ESP | Villarreal v Espanyol 09/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' The corner is swung in but Espanyol can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
89' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
88' 4 - 1 Cyril Ngonge takes over corner duties and expertly finds Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the back of the net. The score is now 4:1.
88' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

88' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Luiz Junior pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
86' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
84' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
84' Charles Pickel (Espanyol) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball goes out of play. Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.
81' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

81' Charles Pickel (Espanyol) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Espanyol.
80' Substitution. Hugo Lopez (Villarreal) in, Alberto Moleiro out.
79' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
76' The resulting corner from Santi Comesana (Villarreal) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
76' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
75' 3:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
73' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Santiago Mourino will be replaced by Alex Freeman (Villarreal).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) replaces Georges Mikautadze.
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Pere Milla as he is replaced by Antoniu Roca (Espanyol).
70' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
66' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly over the bar.
65' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle and it's Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
65' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Villarreal.
65' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Santi Comesana (Villarreal) replacing Dani Parejo.
64' The substitution is prepared. Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tajon Buchanan.
64' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner.
63' Pere Milla (Espanyol) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
62' This should have been a goal! Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) sends a killer pass into the box, but Pape Gueye can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession.
59' The resulting corner, taken by Pere Milla (Espanyol), comes to nothing.
59' We are about to witness a subsitution. Charles Pickel (Espanyol) for Exposito.
59' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a change. Kike Garcia (Espanyol) replaces Roberto Fernandez Jaen.
59' Here comes a substitution. Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) is brought on as a substitute for Tyrhys Dolan.
57' It must be a yellow card. It is. Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) receives the caution after an awful tackle.

55' 4 - 0 Goal! Georges Mikautadze displays great vision and sends a pass to Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the right post. The score is 4:0.
53' Exposito (Espanyol) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Adrian Cordero had an easy-decision to make.
50' 3 - 0 Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Marko Dmitrovic with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:0.
49' Exposito (Espanyol) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
48' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Fernando Calero comes off for Clemens Riedel (Espanyol).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
41' 2 - 0 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Jose Salinas (Espanyol), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 2:0.
40' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
39' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
38' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
35' 1 - 0 Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) finds some space deep inside the box to fire a volley into the back of the net, leaving the keeper helpless. A stunning goal!
34' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
31' PENALTY APPEAL after Exposito (Espanyol) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
28' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
26' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Luiz Junior.
24' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
22' Pere Milla (Espanyol) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
21' Pere Milla (Espanyol) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Espanyol get a corner.
18' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
18' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Espanyol will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
16' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Adrian Cordero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
12' The Espanyol players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
12' Espanyol score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
12' The Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Adrian Cordero rules it out for a foul.
10' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal).
9' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
9' A dangerous looking corner kick from Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is cleared to safety by the defence.
9' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
7' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
7' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

6' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away. Villarreal force a corner. They send men into the box.
6' What was Jose Salinas (Espanyol) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Espanyol.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Villarreal will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Adrian Cordero.
